xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3187: Review-status auto-dispatch floods on 11 wedged closed issues — stale reviewRequestedAt never ages out, CLI processes attempt handler-less dispatch; expanded per operator direction to the DoD rows 1/2/3 terminal-settling rule for the 22-issue close-out backlog

plan.title: Review-status auto-dispatch floods on wedged closed issues — age-out, handler gate, reaper sweep, DoD terminal settling, backlog repair
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: Eleven tracker-closed issues carry an unserviced reviewRequestedAt (18-28 days old) in their journal pipeline block. needsReviewDispatch has no age-out, so every reconcile-on-read in every CLI boot and dashboard boot re-attempts a host-side dispatch that can never succeed (no durable pipeline handler registered outside the server) and logs one line per wedged issue. The closed-issue reaper never clears the residue because it discovers closed issues only via agent/session/workspace/devnet signals, none of which survive. The same wedge blocks close-out for 22 issues (11 named + 11 more tracker-closed residue): their pending/pending/pending statuses miss DoD rows 1/2/3, and rows 1/2/3 have no terminal-settling rule the way PAN-3180 (strike waiver) and PAN-3188 (rows 5/7) established for other landing classes.
narratives.Proposal: Four dispatch-side fixes plus the ledger-side settling rule plus a one-time repair. (1) needsReviewDispatch ages out requests older than REVIEW_REQUEST_MAX_AGE_MS (7 days) via a pure isReviewRequestStale predicate. (2) The reconcile read path clears stale requests through setReviewStatusSync (best-effort, existing merge base passed to avoid re-entrancy) with one warn + activity entry per issue per process. (3) dispatchReviewHostSide early-returns when hasDurableReviewPipelineHandler() is false (CLI processes), logging at most one debug line per process. (4) The closed-issue reaper sweep clears unserviced review intent for tracker-closed issues. (5) evaluateDodGate computes mainVerify first and threads {trackerClosed, landedWork, mainVerifyStatus} into rows 1/2/3: never-requested verdicts settle as skip, negative test/verification verdicts settle as skip only when main-verify passes (superseded), negative review verdicts and closed-without-landed-work stay miss. (6) Docs updated. (7) A checked-in repair script runs pan close (no --accept-* overrides) on the 11 named issues plus discovered tracker-closed residue, using a workspace-built pan.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Deleting review_status rows or rewriting verdict history from the reaper (close-out owns that)
- Changing startDurableReviewPipelineHostSide's false-return contract or the server's registered handler path
- A config knob for the age bound
- Journal-only wedge enumeration in the sweep (the read-path clear handles it)
- Preventing inert pending row resurrection for closed issues with a journal pipeline block (pre-existing, harmless once intent is cleared)
- Re-running or reconstructing verdicts for terminal-closed issues (settling is skip, never fabricated pass)
- Mechanically waiving negative review verdicts, or negative test/verification verdicts without a passing main-verify
- Extending terminal settling to issues closed WITHOUT landed work

autoDecisions.summary: Age bound is 7 days (REVIEW_REQUEST_MAX_AGE_MS), not 24 hours
autoDecisions.rationale: The PAN-1988 auto-heal exists for outage recovery; a weekend dashboard outage must still dispatch Monday. 7d is far beyond planned downtime while a week-old unserviced request is wedged by any measure, and all 11 live wedges are 18-28 days old.

autoDecisions.summary: Stale-request clearing runs on the reconcile read path in any process, best-effort
autoDecisions.rationale: The flood originates in CLI boots, so a deacon-only sweep cannot be the only clear mechanism; writes-on-read through the door is the established pattern (reconcile upsert, closedOut delete), and sandboxed readers still get suppression from the age-out alone.

autoDecisions.summary: Tracker-closed check lives in the async deacon sweep, not the sync read path
autoDecisions.rationale: isIssueClosed is async; needsReviewDispatch stays pure and sync. The issue's '(or its callers)' wording permits caller-side placement.

autoDecisions.summary: Sweep clears intent fields only; no row deletes, no closedOut stamping
autoDecisions.rationale: Deleting the DB row is churn (journal re-reconciles an inert row) and stamping closedOut would fake the close-out ceremony and corrupt pan close's audit.

autoDecisions.summary: DoD rows 1/2/3 settle mechanically only for terminal-closed issues with landed work (row 4 pass)
autoDecisions.rationale: Operator-directed design question. For landed work on a tracker-closed issue the verdict gate's purpose (keeping unverified code off main) is moot; for closed-without-landed the miss must keep demanding an explanation. Mirrors the PAN-3188 skip-chain precedent.

autoDecisions.summary: Never-requested verdicts skip; negative review verdicts never settle; negative test/verification verdicts skip only when main-verify passes on the landed commit
autoDecisions.rationale: Operator asked for the never-requested (MIN-305) vs stale/superseded (PAN-1919) distinction. A specialist that said no is a different fact from one never dispatched (PAN-3180); green landed CI mechanically supersedes a stale test failure but cannot override a human design block; unprovable supersession stays operator judgment.

autoDecisions.summary: Settle, never recover — no re-running or fabricating verdicts for terminal-closed issues
autoDecisions.rationale: Re-dispatching specialists against ancient commits wastes fleet capacity on issues nobody will act on; the close-out ledger records skip with the original verdict preserved (NFR-5).

autoDecisions.summary: Repair covers the full 22-issue backlog via discovery, runs as a checked-in script with a workspace-built pan, no --accept-* overrides
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names 11 PAN issues; the operator counts 22 including other tracker-closed residue. A discovered list is honest evidence, the script satisfies the files_scope lint, and running the installed pan (without the settling item) would produce 22 refusals.

items.title: Add 7-day age-out to needsReviewDispatch with isReviewRequestStale predicate

expected_outputs: both dispatch-decision test files pass, including new age-boundary cases

narrative.Action: In src/lib/review-dispatch-decision.ts add `export const REVIEW_REQUEST_MAX_AGE_MS = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000` and a pure `isReviewRequestStale({ reviewRequestedAt?, now?, maxAgeMs? })` (false when no request; now defaults Date.now(); maxAgeMs defaults the constant). Add optional `now?: number` and `maxRequestAgeMs?: number` to needsReviewDispatch's params and return false when the request is stale (guard right after the missing-request guard). BEFORE/AFTER and full context: PRD WI-1 (drafts/pan-3187.md on overdeck-state). CRITICAL: the two existing test files are time bombs — src/lib/__tests__/review-dispatch-decision.test.ts uses fixed 2026-06-20 dates (already >7d old) and tests/unit/lib/review-dispatch-decision.test.ts uses 2026-07-25 dates; update every expect-true case to pass an explicit `now` so they stay deterministic. Add new cases: 7d+1ms old → false; 7d−1ms old → true; isReviewRequestStale false for missing request; injected maxAgeMs honored.

items.title: Given an unserviced request 7 days + 1 ms old and an injected now, needsReviewDispatch returns false; given one 7 days − 1 ms old, it returns true
isReviewRequestStale returns false for a missing reviewRequestedAt and honors an injected maxAgeMs override
Both pre-existing dispatch-decision test files pass with explicit injected now in every expect-true case, and npx vitest run on both files exits 0
Clear stale review requests through the write door on the reconcile read path

expected_outputs: review-status test files pass, including the stale-clear cases

narrative.Action: In src/lib/review-status.ts, change maybeAutoDispatchReviewHostSide (lines 522-537): when needsReviewDispatch returns false AND isReviewRequestStale is true for the status's reviewRequestedAt, clear the request via `setReviewStatusSync(issueId, { reviewRequestedAt: undefined }, status)` — passing the reconciled status as the `existing` merge base is MANDATORY (NFR-2: otherwise setReviewStatusSync re-enters getReviewStatusSync → reconcile → this hook = recursion). Guard with a per-process `staleReviewRequestClearAttemptedAt` Map so each issue attempts once per process, wrap in try/catch (sandboxed read-only readers fail silently), and on success emit one console.warn plus emitActivityEntrySync({ source: 'cloister', level: 'warn', issueId, message }) — emitActivityEntrySync is already imported at review-status.ts:5 and 'warn' is a valid ActivityLevel. Full snippet: PRD WI-2. Tests in a new src/lib/__tests__/review-status-stale-clear.test.ts following the existing review-status test mocking pattern.

items.title: When the hook runs with an 8-day-old unserviced request, it clears reviewRequestedAt via setReviewStatusSync with the reconciled status passed as existing, attempts no dispatch, and logs exactly one warn across two invocations
When the hook runs with a 1-day-old unserviced request, it preserves reviewRequestedAt and takes the normal dispatch path
npx vitest run src/lib/__tests__/review-status exits 0 and npm run typecheck completes without errors
Skip host-side review dispatch when no durable pipeline handler is registered

narrative.Action: In src/lib/cloister/durable-review-pipeline.ts add `export function hasDurableReviewPipelineHandler(): boolean { return handler !== null; }`. In src/lib/review-status.ts dispatchReviewHostSide (lines 538-556): export the function, destructure hasDurableReviewPipelineHandler from the existing dynamic import, and when it returns false skip the attempt entirely, emitting at most one console.debug per process (module-level `loggedMissingPipelineHandler` flag) — only the dashboard server registers the handler (src/dashboard/server/services/durable-review-pipeline.ts:129), so a CLI dispatch can never succeed. The registered-path behavior (including the existing info-level 'unavailable or already in flight' line) stays byte-identical. Full snippet: PRD WI-3. Tests in new src/lib/cloister/__tests__/durable-review-pipeline.test.ts; the handler is module-global with no unregister, so register only in the last test or isolate per the repo's module-global test pattern.

items.title: hasDurableReviewPipelineHandler returns false in a fresh process and true after registerDurableReviewPipelineHandler is called
With no handler registered, dispatchReviewHostSide resolves without calling console.log and emits at most one console.debug across two calls
npx vitest run src/lib/cloister/__tests__/durable-review-pipeline.test.ts exits 0 and npm run typecheck completes without errors
Sweep and clear unserviced review intent for tracker-closed issues in the deacon reaper

expected_outputs: closed-issue-reaper tests pass, including the four new sweep matrix cases

narrative.Action: In src/lib/cloister/closed-issue-reaper.ts add exported `reapClosedIssueReviewRequests(closedChecks: Map<string, Promise<boolean>>): Promise<string[]>`: enumerate getAllReviewStatusesFromDb(), pre-filter reviewStatus === 'pending', read each candidate's journal via readJournalStatusSync, keep only unserviced requests (reviewRequestedAt set and (no reviewSpawnedAt or request newer than spawn)), check isClosedIssue(issueId, closedChecks), and for tracker-closed matches clear intent via `setReviewStatusSync(issueId, { reviewRequestedAt: undefined, reviewSpawnedAt: undefined }, existing)` — build `existing` as DB row + journal durable overlay and pass it (NFR-2: otherwise the internal getReviewStatusSync re-runs the reconcile and, in the server, dispatches a review for a closed issue). Log each clearing as a deacon action + emitActivityEntrySync (level 'info'). Wire `actions.push(...await reapClosedIssueReviewRequests(closedChecks))` into reconcileClosedIssueAgents immediately before `return actions;` (line 263). Clears intent fields ONLY (D4): no row deletes, no closedOut stamping, verdict history untouched. Full snippet: PRD WI-4. Extend src/lib/cloister/__tests__/closed-issue-reaper.test.ts (14 existing cases) following its mocking pattern.

items.title: When the sweep encounters a tracker-closed issue with an unserviced request, it clears reviewRequestedAt and reviewSpawnedAt and logs a deacon action
When the sweep encounters a tracker-OPEN issue with an identical unserviced request, it preserves the request untouched
When the sweep encounters a tracker-closed issue whose request is already serviced (spawn newer than request) or whose reviewStatus is passed, it preserves the row untouched
reconcileClosedIssueAgents invokes the sweep exactly once per patrol and npx vitest run src/lib/cloister/__tests__/closed-issue-reaper.test.ts exits 0
Settle DoD rows 1/2/3 mechanically for terminal-closed issues with landed work

metadata.parallelSafeReason: touches only src/lib/lifecycle/* and its test file, which no other item in this plan modifies
expected_outputs: dod-gate test suite passes, including the eight new settling cases

narrative.Action: Mirror PAN-3188's skip chain (commit 5a8eef4010) for the verdict rows. In src/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.ts evaluateDodGate (lines 533-585): compute `merged`, then `mainVerify`, then a new `trackerClosed` dep (default isIssueClosed from ../cloister/issue-closed.js), build `{ trackerClosed, landedWork: merged.status === 'pass', mainVerifyStatus: mainVerify.status }` and pass it as an optional second parameter into deps.review/tests/verification (additive signature — existing custom deps keep working); deploy keeps using mainVerify as PAN-3188 wired it. In checkVerdict (lines 238-260) and checkVerificationRow (lines 270-292), after the existing passed/skipped and PAN-3180 strike-waiver branches, add the terminal-settling branch gated on trackerClosed && landedWork: (a) verdict NOT in NEGATIVE_VERDICTS → result 'skip' with observed naming the real (absent/pending) verdict and the settling reason; (b) negative verdict AND row id !== 'review' AND mainVerifyStatus === 'pass' → result 'skip' with observed naming the superseded verdict and the green landed state. Row 1 (review) NEVER takes the supersession branch (D8); closed-without-landed-work and tracker-open issues NEVER settle (D7). Update the DOD_ROWS review/tests/verification entries in dod.ts so the --accept help text states the settling rule in one line each. Find the existing dod-gate test file (ls src/lib/lifecycle/__tests__/) and mirror PAN-3188's skip-chain test structure. Full context: PRD WI-5.

items.title: Tracker-closed + merged pass + reviewStatus pending → row 1 resolves skip; tracker-closed + merged pass + testStatus missing → row 2 resolves skip; tracker-closed + merged pass + verificationStatus pending → row 3 resolves skip

When the gate evaluates tracker-closed + merged miss + reviewStatus pending, row 1 resolves miss (no landed work, no settling); when it evaluates tracker-OPEN + merged pass + reviewStatus pending, row 1 resolves miss
Tracker-closed + merged pass + reviewStatus blocked → row 1 stays miss even when main-verify passes (review negatives are never superseded)
Tracker-closed + merged pass + testStatus failed → row 2 resolves skip when main-verify passes and stays miss when main-verify skips (supersession unprovable)
Every settled skip's observed string contains the original verdict value, evaluateDodGate computes mainVerify before the verdict rows, and npx vitest run src/lib/lifecycle exits 0
Document the intent death lifecycle and the rows 1/2/3 terminal-settling rule

expected_outputs: grep prints the new lifecycle lines in REVIEW-AGENT-ARCHITECTURE.md
grep prints the new settling-rule lines in DEFINITION-OF-DONE.md

narrative.Action: Two files. (1) docs/REVIEW-AGENT-ARCHITECTURE.md lines 63-74 ('The work ↔ review loop', item 1): extend the intent-lifecycle stage list — after the needsReviewDispatch guards stage, add that the intent DIES when older than REVIEW_REQUEST_MAX_AGE_MS (7 days), cleared from the journal on the next status read with a warn log + activity entry, or when the tracker issue closes (the deacon's closed-issue sweep clears it on patrol); and state that host-side dispatch only ever happens in the dashboard server process because only it registers the durable review pipeline handler (CLI processes log one debug line and skip). (2) docs/DEFINITION-OF-DONE.md: document the rows 1/2/3 terminal-settling rule — what settles (skip for terminal-closed with landed work: never-requested verdicts, and negative test/verification verdicts superseded by a passing main-verify), what never settles (closed without landed work, negative review verdicts, unprovable supersession), and that skip never means a fabricated verdict (the observed string preserves the original value).

Run the one-time repair script closing out the wedged and residue backlog via pan close

expected_outputs: the workspace build completes without errors
the script prints a per-issue table of closed-out / refused: <blocking DoD row> / error and exits 0
a subsequent CLI boot prints zero '[review-status] durable review pipeline unavailable' lines

narrative.Action: Create scripts/repair-pan-3187-closed-review-residue.sh (checked in, chmod +x) per the contract in PRD WI-7: hardcode the 11 named issues (PAN-2510 PAN-2230 PAN-2420 PAN-2375 PAN-2167 PAN-2407 PAN-2257 PAN-2258 PAN-2248 PAN-1935 PAN-2150); add a discovery step that enumerates ~/.overdeck/state/<project>/records/*.json across projects for closeOut.closedOut != true, checks tracker state (gh issue view for GitHub projects), prints every additional tracker-closed match, and joins them to the repair list (target: the operator's count of 22 total); then run `pan close <id>` for each with NO --accept-* flags, capture exit codes, and print a final per-issue table (closed-out / refused: <blocking DoD row> / error), exiting 0 regardless. SEQUENCING IS MANDATORY (hazard H7): run `npm run build` in this workspace first and invoke the workspace's built CLI so the run includes the dod-terminal-settling-rows-1-2-3 item — the installed pan is built from main and would refuse all 22 on rows 1/2/3. After the run, verify by reading record files how many reached closeOut.closedOut: true, record per-issue refusals with their exact blocking DoD row in the commit message, and confirm a fresh CLI boot prints zero '[review-status] durable review pipeline unavailable' lines. If an issue refuses on its merged row (work genuinely not landed), stop for that issue and surface it in the completion notes — never override.

items.title: scripts/repair-pan-3187-closed-review-residue.sh exists, is executable, contains no --accept- flag, and prints the discovered backlog list before acting
The script runs against a workspace-built pan containing the settling item, and its output table shows every listed issue as closed-out or refused with a named blocking DoD row
After the run, record files show closeOut.closedOut: true for every repaired issue and a fresh CLI boot prints zero '[review-status] durable review pipeline unavailable' lines
